ext.workflow-nudge.parallel_suggest: [Parallel:Suggest] This prompt has parallel signals ({hints}, score={score}). Consider splitting it into ≥2 sub-agents dispatched together in one message to speed it up. If it should not be split, explain why in your reply.
ext.workflow-nudge.research_codebase_lin: [Research:Fanout] Local codebase lookup detected ({hints}). Dispatch ≥2 `Explore` agents in the same message to search separately (give each a different naming convention or directory slice); no WebSearch and no keyword-expansion stage needed.
ext.workflow-nudge.research_knowledge_li:
[Research:Fanout] Knowledge-lookup request detected ({hints}). Use a two-stage fan-out instead of answering in a single thread:
  Stage A keyword expansion (1-2 agents, report a plain keyword list only): synonyms of the terms + cross-language equivalents + broader/narrower concepts + common misnomers; one track searches the web to confirm the terms the field actually uses.
  Stage B parallel search (all Stage A keywords, dispatch ≥2 agents in the same message): one track scans the atomic memory store/_AIDocs (existing conclusions first; if found, do not search again), one track uses WebSearch/WebFetch for the latest outside knowledge.
  Stage A→B is a real sequential dependency (B needs A's keywords), so keep A light; the parallelism belongs inside B. If fan-out does not fit, say why.
